act of reverential salutation by the speaker

items.question: What qualifies the lord of all gods as worthy of the speaker's homage?
premises: There is a lord identified as sovereign over all gods.
That lord is characterized as worthy of homage.
The speaker performs an act of bowing to that lord.
items.inference: Therefore, the speaker's homage is directed to the supreme lord of all gods because of his worthiness.
items.plain_english: I bow to that lord of all gods, who is worthy of homage.
